purpose: Bind propaganda/information-influence research to TOPA/JANUS provenance, falsification, source-independence, reverse and spiral rules.

janus_roles.TOPA: case admission, classification, falsification and status ceiling
janus_roles.HRain: structural narrative/source/distribution graph; no truth authority
janus_roles.iNAIHR: semantic motif/frame candidates; zero evidence authority
janus_roles.DemiHead: collapse source roots, preserve disagreement and compare competing attributions
janus_roles.Fundamentum: falsifiers, null models, counterexamples and claim ceilings
janus_roles.Fast-CAT: adversarial attack on both propaganda and non-propaganda explanations
janus_roles.AIFC: source lifecycle, canonical IDs, provenance and supersession
janus_roles.Swarm: parallel source discovery only; agent count never equals source count
janus_roles.Aura: symbolic/narrative hypothesis generation only; evidence authority zero

competing_hypotheses: H0 ordinary reporting/opinion without coordinated manipulation
H2 partisan/selective framing without coordinated influence operation
H5 commercial engagement farming or spam
H7 mixed ecosystem with several independent mechanisms

TTP_candidate: observable behavior mapped to frozen definition
attribution_candidate: independent provenance/infrastructure or authoritative evidence with limitations
effect_candidate: audience outcome measured separately from exposure/reach

reverse_spiral.formula: ORIGIN_n -> FORWARD_CASE_MODEL -> REVERSE_REQUIRED_EVIDENCE -> MISSING_BRIDGES -> DEFENSIVE_TEST -> RETURN_n -> ORIGIN_PRIME_n+1
reverse_spiral.promotion: State must advance by new evidence, localized missing bridge, correct demotion, new falsifier or reduced search space; rephrasing is not enrichment.
